verdict.rationale: Workable publishes a per-endpoint API reference (jobs, candidates, ratings, offers, webhooks, permission sets), with required scopes and token types for each endpoint. Probes confirm it is reachable as llms.txt and markdown. None of the evidence shows the interactive part of the story: no try-it console, no runnable code samples, and the probes for a public OpenAPI spec all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/runnable request console, runnable code examples, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
